generation.scope: The intrinsic rank-three marked Ore criterion works also for positive-dimensional edges. For a smooth elliptic ternary point graph the mark is unique. Outside translations of orders two and four, the correction space vanishes except for the inversion linear part, where it has dimension two for every admissible curve. All these positive-edge windows have period one.

open_mathematics: Determine the recurrent corrections for projective-plane ternary graphs from their fixed divisors, then return to all-degree AS membership for the bivariate rank-fifteen plane and general finite-edge windows of tangent dimension at most two.
